title: Equation free data-driven modelling of chaotic processes
summary: We introduce a method for constructing predictive models of non cyclic physical processes directly from time-series data, without assuming an underlying differential equation. The observations define a discrete evolution rule whose recurrent behaviour captures the essential dynamics of the process. Analysing this behaviour across multiple geometric scales leads to probabilistic models in the form of Markov chains.
